editorial.assessment: FaithFood TV is a newer UK church-media service that sits between a simple video host and a managed distribution partner. It is most relevant for a church seeking an ongoing sermon channel, livestream presence and podcast support, rather than a self-service video tool alone. Its published commercial packages are a starting point, but detailed storage, data, ownership and exit conditions should be secured before an archive is transferred.
